en: Hand-colored historic postcard showing a street scene in a European spa town. Two large ornate late-19th-century buildings dominate the view. The left building bears the name "Schloss Heilbronn" and the right one "Villa Nizza." In front stands a tall street clock with decorative lamps. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street; a horse-drawn vehicle is visible near trees at the right. The title "Marienbad." appears at the top, and descriptive captions "Schloss Heilbronn." and "Villa Nizza." appear at the bottom, along with the printer's imprint.
